name: exists_roots_norm_sub_lt_of_norm_coeff_sub_lt
statement: 0 < ε) {a : K} (ha : f.eval a = 0) (hfm : f.Monic) (hgm : g.Monic) (hdeg : g.natDegree = f.natDegree) (hcoeff : ∀ i : ℕ, ‖g.coeff i - f.coeff i‖ < ε) (hg : g.Splits) : ∃ b ∈ g.roots, ‖a - b‖ < ((f.natDegree + 1) * ε) ^ (f.natDegree : ℝ)⁻¹ * max ‖a‖ 1
